title: What If We Terraformed Mars? Scientists Checked

scenes.text: What if we terraformed Mars? Scientists counted, and the planet is short of something.
Mars air is mostly carbon dioxide, but its pressure is only about 0.6 percent of Earth's.
The plan: release trapped CO2 from polar ice, soil and minerals to warm the planet.
A 2018 study counted it all. Even if every bit were released, the pressure would roughly triple, about one fiftieth of what's needed.
And the warming would be under 10 degrees Celsius, on a planet that averages near minus 60.
Nature won't help either: doubling Mars's air naturally would take about ten million years.

description:
What if we terraformed Mars?
A 2018 study of every carbon dioxide source on Mars found there isn't nearly enough to warm it.
What should we run through next?
